walkthroughs.body_html: High biodiversity keeps ecosystems healthy. It gives us food, medicine, clean air and beauty.
Deforestation, pollution, climate change and poaching all reduce biodiversity. Tigers, rhinos and pandas have all been threatened.
National parks, breeding programmes and laws against poaching all help. UK examples include the Lake District and Snowdonia.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between lateral, medial and terminal moraine?
options: Moraines are all the same thing — just piles of rocks.
Lateral moraine forms along the sides of a glacier from rockfall; medial moraine forms where two lateral moraines merge; terminal moraine marks the maximum extent at the snout.
Lateral moraine is the youngest and terminal moraine is the oldest.
It is the process of rain falling from clouds.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between weather and climate?
options: Weather refers to rain and climate refers to temperature.
It is the process of rain falling from clouds.
Weather is short-term atmospheric conditions at a specific time and place; climate is the long-term (typically 30-year) average of weather patterns in a region.
Weather happens outside and climate happens globally.
Weather refers to rain and climate refers to temperature.
It is the process of rain falling from clouds.
It is only water evaporating from puddles and lakes.
The combined loss of water from a surface through evaporation (from soil and water bodies) and transpiration (from plant leaves).
